_about: The structured outputs Desk reads after every call. Each must exist as an output variable on the caller agent that dials: Desk reads the result from these alone. Unknown means empty, never zero or a guess. Checked with `deno task caller-check`. optional: read when present, never required of a caller version.

required.name: outcome
required.describe: One of: booked, advance_required, payment_not_seen, hold_expired, cancelled, options_found, unavailable, moved, kept, question_answered, needs_customer_decision, uncertain, wrong_number, voicemail, phone_menu, no_conversation, disconnected, refused.

required.name: no_match_reason
required.describe: No booking on call 1: no_slot, several_options, advance, price, new_condition or unclear.

required.name: booked_time
required.describe: ISO 8601 with offset, including the year, only if explicitly confirmed. A date with no agreed time: YYYY-MM-DD, never a made-up time.

required.name: booking_reference
required.describe: The reference as given, or empty.

required.name: options
required.describe: Up to 3: [{"time": "ISO 8601", "details": "...", "price_rs": 0, "conditions": "...", "advance_required": false}]. Alternatives offered, or an offer to book on a question call.

required.name: answer
required.describe: What the business answered, in their words.

required.name: also_answer
required.describe: The answer to also_ask, in their words, or empty if they didn't answer.

required.name: advance_amount_rs
required.describe: Advance they asked for, in rupees, or empty.

required.name: advance_redeemable
required.describe: Whether the advance is adjusted against the bill, in their words, or empty.

required.name: advance_refund
required.describe: Whether it's refunded if the customer doesn't come or cancels, in their words, or empty.

required.name: advance_hold
required.describe: yes or no: they said they'll keep the slot until the customer decides. Empty if they didn't say.

required.name: payment_mode
required.describe: How to pay: upi, bank_transfer, qr, link, cash or other, or empty.

required.name: payment_address
required.describe: Where to pay: the UPI ID, number or account as given. Spelt out letter by letter, put it together as one ID ("paragon at o k h d f c" is paragon@okhdfc) and only if it was read back whole; if any part is unclear, empty.

required.name: payee_name
required.describe: Who the payment goes to, or empty.

required.name: payment_deadline
required.describe: ISO 8601 with offset, or empty.

required.name: payment_status
required.describe: received, not_seen, wrong_amount, disputed or unclear.

required.name: callback_time
required.describe: When they asked us to call back: ISO 8601 with offset, resolved from the call's date and time ("in 40 minutes" is 40 minutes after now), or their words if it can't be placed; empty if they didn't say.

required.name: cancel_status
required.describe: cancelled, charge_pending, not_cancelled or unclear.

required.name: cancel_charge_rs
required.describe: Any charge or lost deposit they stated, or empty.

required.name: refund_stated
required.describe: What they said about refunding the advance, in their words, or empty.

required.name: original_booking_status
required.describe: kept, moved, cancelled or unclear.

required.name: contact_name
required.describe: Staff member's name, if given.

required.name: possible_unintended_commitment
required.describe: yes or no: they may have reserved something nobody authorised.

required.name: unintended_commitment_details
required.describe: Their exact words, or empty.

required.name: opt_out_requested
required.describe: yes or no: they asked not to be called.

required.name: summary
required.describe: 2 to 3 factual sentences, not a success story.

optional.name: uncertainties
optional.describe: Anything left unresolved or contradicted on the call (a slot said to be free, then taken; a detail they couldn't confirm), in plain words, or empty.
